Nov. 19Willis Lease Finance Corporation Expands Fleet with Acquisition of Two Airbus A320 AircraftCI Nov. 19Willis Lease Finance Acquires Two Airbus A320 AircraftMT

Willis Lease Finance Corporation completed the acquisition of two Airbus A320 aircraft. The acquisitions complement the Company?s core engine leasing business and reflect its continued commitment to strategically expanding its aviation asset portfolio to meet growing customer demand. The addition of both a new-generation A320neo and an A320ceo reflects a disciplined approach to investing in diverse assets.

Willis Lease Finance Corporation, along with its subsidiaries, is a lessor and services commercial aircraft and aircraft engines. The Company operates in two segments: Leasing and Related Operations, and Spare Parts Sales. The Leasing and Related Operations segment involves acquiring and leasing, primarily pursuant to operating leases, commercial aircraft, aircraft engines and other aircraft equipment and the selective purchase and resale of commercial aircraft engines and other aircraft equipment and other related businesses. The Spare Parts Sales segment involves the purchase and resale of after-market engine parts, whole engines, engine modules and portable aircraft components. Also, it provides end-of-life solutions for the surplus aircraft and engines, as well as managing the full life cycle of its lease assets. Its subsidiaries include WEST Engine Funding LLC, Willis Aeronautical Services, Inc., Coconut Creek Aviation Assets LLC, Facility Engine Acquisition LLC, and others.

The MSCI ESG score assesses a company’s environmental, social, and governance practices relative to its industry peers. Companies are rated from CCC (laggard) to AAA (leader). This rating helps investors incorporate sustainability risks and opportunities into their investment decisions.
